Academy
Bridging Skill Gaps with Innovative Robotics and AI Education

The Academy at ARTPARK-IISc is dedicated to nurturing talent and accelerating skills development at both regional and national levels. Focused on bridging the gap in translating knowledge into real-world applications, these programs introduce motivated individuals to the fields of Robotics and Autonomous Technologies. We provide participants with expert guidance, cutting-edge infrastructure, and extensive learning opportunities, empowering them to advance their skills in Robotics, AI, and Machine Learning, and achieve their technical and professional aspirations.

Spark Sessions

For aspiring entrepreneurs keen on leveraging deep-technologies to solve challenges of the developing world.

We select a cohort of about 20 entrepreneurs and offer sessions with interactive Q&As, peer feedback and breakout discussions.

Sessions are designed to support founders and teams with expert advice on aspects such as developing MVPs, defining user and business models, product-market fit, and fundraising.

UG-PG Fellowships

 ARTPARK-IISc offers Top-Up Fellowships and Stipends for innovative student projects in Robotics, Autonomous Systems, and AI. Open to students from reputable Indian higher-education institutions, this fellowship supports final-year Bachelor's and Master's students working on cutting-edge projects. Started from September 2023 to March 2024, with an extension option until July 2024, the fellowship provided a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,500 for Master’s students and Rs. 7,000 for Bachelor's students. With 15 projects selected, 29 students (18 UG, 11 PG) are involved, along with 14 supervisors from their parent institutions.

Summer Internships

Internships in SWARM Robotics

Duration : 2 Months (June to July 2024)

The project aims to design and develop the Rigbetel Tortoise Bot for Swarm Robotics, focusing on defense applications. We strive to create a versatile, agile, and robust robotic platform capable of autonomous navigation, surveillance, reconnaissance, and coordination in complex and hostile environments, thereby enhancing defense capabilities and situational awareness.

A total of 9 students have been selected for this summer internship across various institutes and universities.

Applied Research Capability Network (ARCNet)

ARCNet is a student-led program under ARTPARK @ IISc. The aim of the centre is to provide skill-building opportunities via courses, workshops and participation in live projects to students and early professionals in robotics and AI.

The sessions were very interactive and not just theoretical. The mentors/presenters were very open and answered all of the questions. ”
